name: Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with feet together and hands clasped at your chest.
Take a wide step out to the right.
Sit your hips back and bend the right knee, keeping the left leg straight.
Lower as far as is comfortable with both feet flat.
Push through the right heel to return. Finish the set, then switch sides.
cues: Both feet flat on the floor
Sit back into the bent hip

common_mistakes.mistake: Bent knee shoots past the toes
Heel of the bent leg lifts
common_mistakes.fix: Step less wide and keep weight in the heel
Keep the chest up and go less deep
